QA Automation Engineer, GreenGrid — Feb 2025 - Present
Lead automation efforts for a B2B energy management web application. Implemented and maintained automated regression suites using Selenium and TestNG to cover core user flows (meter onboarding, usage analytics, billing export), reducing manual regression time by 65%. Built API test collections in Postman for internal billing and device provisioning services, uncovering and logging intermittent failures that improved API uptime SLAs by 8%. Integrated Selenium suites with Jenkins for nightly CI runs and parallel execution, decreasing pipeline feedback time by 40%. Used Git for version control, Jira for tracking defects and feature tasks, and Confluence to document test plans and runbooks. Collaborated with developers to reproduce issues and validate fixes using Playwright for cross-browser checks when needed.
